summary: openclaw-upgrade.py reads the compatibility manifests next to itself first; CLAW_RUNTIME_ROOT is only a fallback when the script's folder has no openclaw-compat.
reason: S24 01/11 20:46: the production dry run refused (compat owner absent, egress fix not seen) because the Claw bridge carried CLAW_RUNTIME_ROOT pinned to the replaced 31/10 release; supervisors pin the physical release path on purpose, so a long-lived caller can hold a stale one. The switch ran only after forcing the variable.
